effect_description_eng:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
